messages:
sara: Heads-up — planned control-plane KV router maintenance in eu-west1 this Sunday. Proposed window: Sun 02:00–03:00 UTC. Expected impact: short-lived control-plane 500s for routing calls and transient increased latencies. Serving inference should fall back to regional caches; Dedicated customers unaffected. pinging @ash-oncall for handoff and @lina-support for customer copy.

incident-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: ID=mt-2026-17644-eu-kv, window=2026-03-22T02:00:00Z/2026-03-22T03:00:00Z. Subscribe: #incidents

ash-oncall: I can take the on-call handoff for the window. I’ll be primary on the bridge. Quick confirm: are we doing rolling router restarts or a short drain+restart sequence?

kevin: Rolling restarts with staggered traffic weights (10m batches) so we avoid full-region flaps. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kvr-drain

sara: Correct — rolling restarts. Runbook step snippet for comms:
```
- T-30m: post status update (pre-start)
- T+0: start maintenance, post status: degraded
- T+15m: update progress
- T+60m: complete, post resolved
```

lina-support: Drafted customer notification for affected hosted API users. PTAL:
```
Subject: Planned maintenance — control-plane routing (eu-west1)
Body:
Hello,
We will perform maintenance on our control-plane routing layer in eu-west1 on Sun 22 Mar, 02:00–03:00 UTC. During this window some API requests that rely on control-plane routing may see brief 500 errors or slightly elevated latencies. Most requests will continue to be served via regional caches and retries. Customers with Dedicated capacity are not impacted.
If you expect production traffic during this window and want us to exclude your account from reroutes, reply and we’ll coordinate.
Thanks — Redwood Inference Ops
```

mike-prodops: Suggest adding these two lines to the statuspage copy to reduce ticket volume: please include an ETA for next update and note that automated retries are safe. Also add a link to the runbook for integrations teams.

kevin: Good call. Status page snippet (short):
```
We are performing scheduled maintenance on control-plane routing in eu-west1. Some requests may return 500s or experience higher latency. Our mitigation (rolling restarts and fallback to regional caches) is active. Next update in 15 minutes.
```

ash-oncall: Oncall checklist before start:
- Confirm backup config pushed to routers
- Increase retry windows at ingress for 2x
- Pager escalation set to oncall-sre -> eng-sre-lead
- Bridge: https://zoom.link/ops-bridge

sara: @ash-oncall set. I pushed the preflight announcement to #announcements and scheduled the statuspage update. @lina-support please send the customer email at T-60m.

lina-support: Will send at T-60. Copy approved by sara and kevin. Adding a short FAQ for customers who ask about embeddings/keys.

incident-bot: Reminder: T-30m pre-start alert in 30 minutes for maintenance mt-2026-17644-eu-kv

ash-oncall: I'll post the T-0 status update and monitor logs for error spikes. If we see >1% 5xx across control-plane calls for 10m, we abort and roll back.

kevin: Post-maint checklist: confirm no residual routing mismatch, validate KV compact stats, and run smoke tests against sample tenants.

sara: Thanks team — I’ll update the internal incident template with the exact timeline after completion. Everyone on the bridge please react with :thumbsup: when ready.

ash-oncall: :thumbsup:
kevin: :thumbsup:
lina-support: :thumbsup:

sara: Closing note for later: include a short post-mortem blurb for customers if we have any aborted steps. Keep it high level and action-oriented.
